ideas.pitch: A high-intensity web training simulator tailored specifically for practicing 60-question, 30-minute rapid quantitative aptitude tests.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Online Round Format: Multiple-choice or numerical quantitative aptitude questions over 60 questions in 30 minutes.
ideas.title: QuantAptitudeDrill
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific pain point of time management and rapid problem-solving required for Round 1 of Speed Quant.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic sandbox and numerical solver for advanced probability and mathematical brainteasers typical of onsite quant finals.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Onsite Finale (IIT Kanpur – Techkriti' 27) Format: Numerical/short answer type quantitative mathematical questions involving probabilistic knowledge.
ideas.title: ProbSolveBenchmark
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact profile of difficult numerical and probabilistic math questions featured in the onsite finale.

ideas.pitch: A terminal-first calculation and estimation scratchpad optimized for lightning-fast mental math checks and combinatorial expansions.
ideas.problem_statement: Speed Quant: a high-octane challenge that merges mathematical brilliance with rapid problem-solving and mastering the clock.
ideas.title: SpeedCalcEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and reducing friction during high-pressure quantitative calculations.

ideas.pitch: A spaced-repetition and flashcard trainer focused entirely on classic quant interview brainteasers, combinatorics, and expected value problems.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Onsite Finale incorporating brainstorming, probabilistic knowledge, and mathematical problem-solving.
ideas.title: QuantFlashDrill
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a practical study utility for competitors prepping for the complex final round at IIT Kanpur.

ideas.pitch: A local telemetry logger and strategy tracker for reviewing speed-test performance anomalies, timing bottlenecks, and error patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Online Round requiring smart choices and staying ahead of the competition under tight time constraints.
ideas.title: MathHeuristicsLog
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs data-driven performance tracking to help solo competitors optimize their test-taking strategy.
